experiments.criterion: PASS if the inverse-variance-weighted mean residual (measured - predicted) over usable held-out exposures has Mahalanobis distance d^2 < 11.83 (the 99.73 % / "3 sigma" region for 2 dof) under Sigma = Sigma_prediction(mean held-out epoch) + Sigma_measurement(mean). INCONCLUSIVE if fewer than 10 usable held-out exposures. Otherwise FAIL.
experiments.primary_model: linear_parallax (SPHEREx-only: position, proper motion and parallax all fitted to training data)
experiments.classification: Independent held-out recovery (SPHEREx-only motion model; catalogue used to identify the source and register frames)
disclosures: Catalogue (Gaia DR3) astrometry was used to locate the source in training images (centroid search seed) and to register frames with field stars; the primary prediction itself uses only SPHEREx positions.
The experimenter (an AI coding agent working for the team) had seen published Gaia DR3 values for this source before the experiment; it did not view any held-out pixel.
Git commit timestamps are self-reported. An externally timestamped record (e.g. pushing the commit) is stronger evidence of when the prediction was frozen.

negative_controls.description: Gaia DR3 stars with |pm| < 20 mas/yr, G 11.5–16.5, RUWE < 1.4, isolated (no comparable neighbour within 20 arcsec), within 4 arcmin of each field centre. Each star is excluded from the registration reference set while it is measured.

injections.label: SYNTHETIC INJECTIONS - not real astronomical sources
injections.description: ePSF point sources added to real SPHEREx cutouts (every third exposure of the Epsilon Indi B field, 150 exposures, 4 visits) at an empty position, moving at position angle 135 deg. Measured blind (stationary seed) with production code and thresholds. Source photon noise not simulated.

limitations: The validation set is small (five named targets, one held-out experiment, tens of control stars); it does not establish full-sky performance.
Negative controls are bright-ish isolated Gaia stars; faint, crowded or nebular regions are not represented.
Three of the five NASA targets (Barnard's Star, RW Aur, R Dra) saturate SPHEREx; their core measurements are excluded and reported as such.
Proper motions of a binary (Epsilon Indi Ba/Bb) include orbital photocentre motion, so differences from Gaia DR3 are expected at the few-sigma level.
